Step forward: Proud to join an elite, global network as a McKinsey Forward program graduate! ⭐🎓

I have officially completed the McKinsey Forward program! The absolute highlight of this highly structured journey was concluding the curriculum with live, interactive sessions with McKinsey employees.

This intensive experience has completely changed my approach to professional challenges. Instead of relying on guesswork, I am now leaning heavily into a proven, high-impact toolkit:

➖ Structured Problem Solving
➖ Communicating for Impact
➖ Digital & AI Fluency
➖ Collaborative Leadership
➖ Emotional Intelligence
➖ Thriving in Modern Work Culture

A massive thank you to the McKinsey Forward team for such a powerful experience!

Built something real. Shipped it. Learned 10x more than any classroom ever taught me. 🚀💻

Just completed my first full-stack AI project — a RAG-based document Q&A system.

Stack used:
→ Python + FastAPI backend
→ LangChain + ChromaDB for RAG
→ Gemini API for answers
→ React frontend

Hardest part? Not the code. Believing I could actually finish it.

Started 3 weeks ago with zero RAG knowledge. Broke things. Fixed things. Shipped it.

Building in public from Bhopal 🇮🇳

200 LeetCode problems. 3 months. Here is what actually changed. 💻⚡

Day 1 — couldn't solve an easy array problem without hints.
Day 90 — solved a medium graph problem in 20 minutes.

What worked:
→ 1 problem every morning before college
→ Writing logic in plain English first
→ Reviewing wrong answers after 3 days

What didn't work:
→ Watching solutions without trying first
→ Grinding 5 problems a day and burning out

Consistency beats intensity every single time.

What's your DSA tip? 👇

#LeetCode #DSA #PlacementPrep #CSStudents #IndianEngineers #100DaysOfCode

48 hours. No sleep. 1 idea we almost gave up on at 3 AM. 🎤⚡

Just attended my first national level hackathon and I'm still processing everything.

We didn't win. But here's what I gained:
→ Met 200+ CS students grinding just like me
→ Built a working prototype in 48 hours
→ Learned more in 2 days than 2 weeks of college
→ Got feedback from real industry mentors

Losing never felt this good.

If you're hesitating to register for that hackathon — just do it.

Got my first tech internship. Still can't believe it's real. 🎓💼

3rd year CSE student from Bhopal. No tier-1 college. No fancy connections.

Just 8 months of consistent work:
→ 200+ LeetCode problems
→ 3 real projects on GitHub
→ 2 certifications
→ 50+ failed applications

The 51st said yes.

To every student grinding in a Tier-2 city — your location doesn't define your destination.

Keep building. Keep applying.

Feel free to reach out if you need help! 👇
